newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed flat at 3.09 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed flat at 3.09 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland fixed the zloty at 3.1200 to the dollar, up from 3.1210 on Friday and at 1.8110 to the mark, down from 1.8100, the NBP said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 3.09 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, flat against Friday's 3.10 percent fix.
The zloty was at 3.12 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes together with dollar and mark rates on world markets. On Friday the floating parity fixing was 3.09 percent.
